note.short: Append a note to an existing activity
note.long:
Append a note to an existing activity after it was logged.

If no date-index is provided, appends to the last activity.
To update a specific activity, provide its key (YYYY-MM-DD-NN).

Examples:
  tock note "Followed up with summary"
  tock note 2026-03-14-02 "Added meeting outcome"
  tock note 2026-03-14-02 "Added meeting outcome" --json
note.flag.json: Output the updated activity in JSON format
tag.short: Append tags to an existing activity
tag.long:
Append tags to an existing activity after it was logged.

If no date-index is provided, appends tags to the last activity.
To update a specific activity, provide its key (YYYY-MM-DD-NN).

Examples:
  tock tag review urgent
  tock tag 2026-03-14-02 review urgent
  tock tag 2026-03-14-02 review urgent --json
tag.flag.json: Output the updated activity in JSON format
tag.error.required: at least one tag is required
current.long:
Lists all currently running activities.

You can format the output using Go templates with the --format flag.
Available variables:
  .Project      - Project name
  .Description  - Activity description
  .StartTime    - Start time (time.Time object)
  .EndTime      - End time (time.Time object, usually nil for running activities)
  .Duration     - Activity duration (time.Duration object)
  .DurationHMS  - Duration formatted as HH:MM:SS
current.flag.format: Format output using a Go template (e.g. '{{.Project}}: {{.Duration}}'). See --help for variables.
continue.flag.description: the description of the new activity
continue.flag.project: the project to which the new activity belongs
continue.flag.time: the time for changing the activity status (HH:MM)
continue.flag.json: Output the created activity in JSON format
last.flag.number: Number of recent activities to show

remove.long:
Remove an activity from the log.

If no argument is provided, removes the last activity.
To remove a specific activity, provide its index ID (YYYY-MM-DD-NN).

Examples:
  tock remove                     # Remove last activity
  tock remove -y                  # Remove last activity without confirmation
  tock remove 2023-10-15-01       # Remove specific activity

edit.long:
Edit an existing activity instead of changing the log file by hand.

Without flags an interactive editor opens: without a date-index you can browse the days and pick
the entry to change, with a date-index the form for that entry opens directly.
With flags the change is applied right away; without a date-index the last activity is edited.

Examples:
  tock edit                                  # browse and edit interactively
  tock edit 2026-03-14-02                    # open the editor for one entry
  tock edit -e 17:30                         # fix the end time of the last activity
  tock edit 2026-03-14-02 -p Tock -d Review  # fix project and description
  tock edit 2026-03-14-02 --day 2026-03-15   # move the entry to another day
  tock edit 2026-03-14-02 --duration 90m     # keep the start, set a new duration
  tock edit 2026-03-14-02 --clear-end        # make the entry running again
edit.flag.day: Move the activity to this day (YYYY-MM-DD)
edit.flag.start: New start time (HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)
edit.flag.end: New end time (HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM)
edit.flag.duration: New duration measured from the start time (e.g. 1h, 90m)
edit.flag.clear_end: Drop the end time so the activity is running again
edit.flag.json: Output the updated activity in JSON format
edit.list.help: enter: edit, left/right: change day, up/down: select, q: quit
edit.form.title: Edit activity (%s)

remind.short: Manage reminders: things to do on a day or at a time
remind.long:
Manage reminders: things to do on a day or at a time, once or repeatedly.

Without a command the interactive list opens. A reminder can be started as a tracked
activity ('tock remind start'), which also marks it done.

Notifications come from the macOS menu bar icon ('tock tray'), so they only go out while it runs.

Examples:
  tock remind add "Team sync" -p Work --on mon --at 17:30 --every weekly --notify 10m
  tock remind add "Renew domain" --on 2026-11-16 --every yearly
  tock remind list --week
  tock remind done 3
  tock remind snooze 4 15m
  tock remind start 4
remind.flag.title: New reminder title
remind.flag.project: Project used when the reminder is started as an activity
remind.flag.on: Day: YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow or a weekday like mon (default today)
remind.flag.at: Time of day (HH:MM); without it the reminder is all-day
remind.flag.all_day: Drop the time of day and make the reminder all-day
remind.flag.every: Repeat: daily, weekdays, weekly[:mon,thu], monthly[:16|:last|:2-tue|:last-fri], yearly, or an interval like 3d, 2w, 6m, 1y
remind.flag.until: Last day of the repeat (YYYY-MM-DD); 'none' removes it
remind.flag.count: Stop the repeat after this many occurrences
remind.flag.notify: Notify this long before it is due (e.g. 10m, 1h; up to a week)
remind.flag.date: Act on the occurrence on this day instead of the current one (YYYY-MM-DD)
remind.add.short: Add a one-off or repeating reminder
remind.add.long:
Add a one-off or repeating reminder.

Without a title the interactive form opens, filled in from the flags.

Examples:
  tock remind add "Send invoice" -p Admin --on 2026-11-16 --at 13:00 --every monthly
  tock remind add "Standup" -p Work --at 09:30 --every weekdays
  tock remind add "Pay rent" --on 2026-11-18 --every monthly:18
  tock remind add "Water plants" --every 3d --count 10
remind.edit.long:
Edit a reminder by its ID.

Without flags the interactive form opens. With flags the change is applied right away;
--on keeps the time of day, --at sets it, --all-day drops it.

Examples:
  tock remind edit 4
  tock remind edit 4 --at 18:00
  tock remind edit 4 --every weekly:mon,thu --until 2026-12-31

remind.snooze.long:
Push a reminder occurrence back by a duration (15m, 1h) or to a time of day (17:45).
Without one it is snoozed for reminders.snooze from the config (default 10m).
remind.start.short: Start tracking a reminder as an activity
remind.start.long:
Start an activity from a reminder: its project and title become the activity's project
and description, and the occurrence is marked done. A running activity is stopped first.

remind.remove.long: Remove a reminder by its ID, or with --date only that occurrence of a repeating one.
